lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through a national mapping event (mapatón) organized by HOT in Ecuador 2025, where volunteers digitized building structures from satellite imagery and field surveys into OpenStreetMap. The resulting GeoJSON file contains the spatial geometry and attributes of mapped buildings for use in exposure assessment.

sources.name: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT)
sources.description: OpenStreetMap building footprint data collected through community mapping (mapatón) in Ecuador 2025. Provides spatial inventory of building structures for disaster risk assessment.
